annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院 (State Council of the People's Republic of China)
key_provisions_or_claims: Targets 2025 indicators: 9 million+ elder-care beds, 55% nursing beds, universal visiting for vulnerable elderly.
Promotes AI, big data and 5G in elderly products, including home service robots and assistive devices.
Supports exoskeleton rehabilitation, intelligent prostheses, and robots for lifting, turning and inspection in care.
Funds major R&D on brain-computer interaction rehabilitation robots and a smart service robot action plan.
Calls for elder-care standards, quality certification, comprehensive supervision and a new elder-care services law.
annotation.summary_en: China's State Council 14th Five-Year Plan for national aging undertakings and the elder-care service system (Dec 2021). It mainly covers social security, elder-care services, health and legal protection. It has limited embodied-AI content: promoting smart elderly products, care and rehabilitation robots, exoskeletons and prostheses, plus related standards and R&D support.
annotation.title_clean: 国务院关于印发“十四五”国家老龄事业发展和养老服务体系规划的通知
annotation.title_en: State Council Notice on Issuing the 14th Five-Year National Plan for Aging Undertakings and the Elder-Care Service System
